tokens.npc_dota_hero_pudge_bio: In the Fields of Endless Carnage, far to the south of Quoidge, a corpulent figure works tirelessly through the night--dismembering, disembowelling, piling up the limbs and viscera of the fallen that the battlefield might be clear by dawn. In this cursed realm, nothing can decay or decompose; no corpse may ever return to the earth from which it sprang, no matter how deep you dig the grave. Flocked by carrion birds who need him to cut their meals into beak-sized chunks, Pudge the Butcher hones his skills with blades that grow sharper the longer he uses them. Swish, swish, thunk. Flesh falls from the bone; tendons and ligaments part like wet paper. And while he always had a taste for the butchery, over the ages, Pudge has developed a taste for its byproduct as well. Starting with a gobbet of muscle here, a sip of blood there...before long he was thrusting his jaws deep into the toughest of torsos, like a dog gnawing at rags. Even those who are beyond fearing the Reaper, fear the Butcher.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_pudge_hype: Each carefully aimed throw of Pudge's signature hook strikes fear into his foes. Pulling his enemies near to carve them with his cleavers, he gains additional health and damage with every kill, and soon becomes an unstoppable killer.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_pudge_npedesc1: Hooks and pulls enemies towards him

Other {{M|Summons|text=player-controlled units}} do not count. **** When the dying enemy hero is debuff-affected sourceed to Pudge. ** For {{A|Meepo|Meepo Clones}}, they grant 1 stack upon being {{M|forced killed}}. * Does not grant a stack in the following conditions: ** Killing an {{M|allied hero|x}}. ** Considers {{M|The Double}}, enemy {{M|illusions}}, and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as creeps. ** Upon the enemy's {{M|reincarnation}} sources proc.

fields.value: Chows down and pulls the unit-targeted enemy up to a certain minimum distance.

fields.name: interacts
mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability has two main components:
** All ability effects are applied as long as Pudge is {{M|channeling}} the ability on the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]]
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** Applies a {{M|forced movement}} with the following ability effects:
***** {{M|Stun}}
***** Offensively pulls the affected unit toward Pudge.
***** Grants {{M|True Sight}} over the affected unit.
***** {{Symbol|Vision|Base}}
****** Grants a {{#var:Dismember value3}} ({{Symbol|bonus t3r}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Dismember value3 tal}}|20tal}})-second 200-radius [[vision]] over the affected enemy unit.
****** The vision granted does not follow the affected unit, and is independent of the channeling duration.
***** {{M|Dispels}} the {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|pudge_dismember_pull}} debuff once the unit is within the pull distance threshold.
**** Has the following ability interactions:
***** {{Symbol|Invisible}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
****** [[Invisible]] sources applied on the affected unit do not interrupt the channeling.
****** This also nullifies the {{M|True Sight}} applied.
***** The following sources applied on the affected enemy unit interrupts the channeling.
****** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
****** {{M|Invulnerable}} sources.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] 
*** The following components are applied within the same intervals, starting immediately per {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|pudge_dismember}} application:
**** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
***** The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
**** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
***** The self-{{M|heal}} component.
****** Heals for the full value regardless of the damage instance value, and does not continue to heal at full {{M|health}}.
****** Considers enemy {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes; enemy {{M|Couriers}} as creeps.
****** Reapplying the buff refreshes its duration.

abilities: Meat Hook yanks a single target out of position into the team for a Dismember.
Linken's Sphere blocks Dismember, and BKB ignores the Hook's stun and rot.
items: Linken's Sphere blocks Pudge's key single-target spell.
Lotus Orb reflects and dispels Pudge's targeted disable.
Eul's Scepter (or any stun) interrupts Pudge's channelled spell.
Spell immunity to fight through disables and magic.
Armor and an AoE slow that cuts healing.
A popular core pickup on this hero.
Burst move speed and bonus physical damage.
To return burst damage to attackers.
